dish: A5 Wagyu Strip with Smoked Bone Marrow & Charred Scallion Glaze
sensoryRole: Deep umami climax with intense intramuscular fat rendering cut by charred allium acidity.
technique: Sear in dry smoking cast iron 90 seconds per side. Rest 8 minutes on elevated wire rack. Top with cold smoked marrow butter.
plating: Carve into 1cm batons, expose rosy interior, finish with sea salt flakes.
